text: Fair-balance required per ABPI 2023 Code §6.1. Efficacy claim must be accompanied by safety profile. Recommend adding: 'with a safety profile consistent with pembrolizumab monotherapy (grade ≥3 AEs: 52% vs 44% control arm).'

Slide 19 comparative claim should be qualified — see agentic report Finding 2. The phrase 'best-in-class tolerability with fewer discontinuations than any comparator' is not supported by head-to-head data. Should Fix.
